text:
maria: Hey team — BryTech POC is stuck. Customer says security questionnaire + SSO + VPC peering are blocking exec sign-off. They want final answers by EOD tomorrow. Also pressing on committed-month pricing for Dedicated. Need owners.

raj: On it. I can take SSO + IP allowlist. @maria pls share the Okta contact.

maria: Contact is ken.bry@brytech.com — he asked for Okta SAML metadata and SCIM support.

linh: Reviewing the sec questionnaire now. Top asks: SOC2 scope & timeline, data residency, KMS/HSM integration, encryption at rest/in transit, RBAC/audit logs, pen-test artifacts. Do they require on-prem?

olivia: They mentioned regulated healthcare workloads; prefer VPC peering + customer-managed KMS if possible.

linh: We support external KMS (AWS KMS) and can outline HSM options. I'll draft answers for those sections.

maria: Legal flagged subprocessors in the DPA — BryTech wants tighter language.

tom: I can handle DPA edits. Need list of subprocessors + a simple data flow diagram for their reviewers.

raj: POC infra note: we can provision Dedicated with a 3-month commit. Back-of-envelope: ~USD 28k/mo for 4x A100 equiv + orchestration; estimate subject to finance sign-off and potential volume discount.

maria: @finance — can you sanity-check that number? we need a quick placeholder to tell BryTech execs.

deploy-bot: Maintenance notice: scheduled network window next Wed may affect VPC peering tests — https://status.redwood.ai/notice-234 :warning:

linh: That maintenance could delay their connectivity test. I'll call that out to BryTech and propose a workaround window.

olivia: Action list for internal prep:
- raj: SSO metadata, peering config, and test plan by EOD tomorrow
- linh: complete security questionnaire answers + pen-test summary
- tom: DPA draft with subprocessors list
- maria: schedule exec review call with BryTech (target Thu 10am PT)
- finance: provisional pricing confirmation

raj: SAML metadata snippet I'll use for testing: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.ai/saml">...</EntityDescriptor>```

maria: Also they want example SLA numbers (p99 latency) for sevrun-13b and a throughput target. Anyone able to pull console numbers quickly?

olivia: I'll pull per-model p95/p99 from Console and paste here before the prep call.

linh: One more BryTech ask: SOC2 Type II report + ISO27001. We have SOC2 in progress. I'll draft a responsibility matrix and a timeline to Type II.

tom: We'll provide SOC2 scope letter and standard subprocessor list; legal will include a brief timeline and mitigation commitments.

maria: Scheduling a 30min internal prep at 1600 today — please join and bring your updates. Goal: unblock exec sign-off next week. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Joining.

raj: Joining.

linh: Joining.

maria: Thanks everyone — let's aim to have the security questionnaire posted to the BryTech share by EOD tomorrow and the provisional pricing finalized. We'll update the thread with attachments.

raj: I'll post test plan + SAML config here once ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: keep all PII out of Slack; use secure share for docs.

maria: Noted. I'll use the secure upload link when sending BryTech docs.

maria: If anything changes before the prep meeting ping me directly.

olivia: Copy — prepping metrics now.

linh: Will prioritize the questionnaire.

maria: Team, thanks — let's get this over the line. :rocket:
